question: Should Twilio RCS ship as a bundled OpenClaw channel, or should this implementation be distributed as an external plugin or ClawHub package?
rationale: The implementation appears able to use existing plugin seams, but bundling a service-specific channel is a product and ownership choice that code review cannot safely make.

options.title: Externalize as plugin or ClawHub package
options.body: Move the RCS channel out of the bundled distribution while preserving its SDK-based implementation, package metadata, setup docs, secret contract, and smoke proof.

options.title: Sponsor a bundled exception
options.body: Keep the bundled RCS channel only with explicit owner approval, exact-head dependency authorization, and accepted carrier/device production proof requirements.

recommendation.title: Externalize as plugin or ClawHub package
recommendation.body: Move the RCS channel out of the bundled distribution while preserving its SDK-based implementation, package metadata, setup docs, secret contract, and smoke proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest merged Twilio channel precedent and bundled-channel ownership history point to this person for the distribution-boundary decision.
